name: Kugaya Masaki
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
Job: Editor-in-Chief at a Publishing Company
Hobby: Gambling, Work
Likes: Horse Racing, Alcohol, Tobacco
Dislikes: Sweets

A writer whose name is well known.
He has a calm way of speaking despite his age, but he has a side that is a bit old mannish.
A capable person who is always ready to work, but on his own time he can be surprisingly slovenly.
